mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_master ( board_type_code, board_name, use_comment_yn, use_yn, menu_id ) VALUES ( #{boardTypeCode}, #{boardName}, #{useCommentYn}, #{useYn}, #{menuId} )
mapper.select: SELECT board_id, board_type_code, board_name, use_comment_yn, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn, menu_id FROM board_master
SELECT board_id, board_type_code, board_name, use_comment_yn, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_yn, menu_id FROM board_master WHERE board_id = #{masterId}
mapper.update: UPDATE board_master SET board_type_code = #{boardTypeCode}, board_name = #{boardName}, use_comment_yn = #{useCommentYn}, use_yn = #{useYn} WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
